text: Reuse-first direction recorded: Skia is the lead candidate, not an adopted backend. Primary-source review found existing C wrappers and packaged native assets in SkiaSharp; no .NET runtime is conceptually needed to call that native C ABI. GPU sharing, exact C API coverage, artifact features and text ownership remain unprobed. See the graphics plan G-0. Do not duplicate shader/atlas/tessellation work before the backend decision.
